  name: String!
  value: Float

  quantity: String

  limitEditable: Boolean!

enum Comparison {

type Subscription {

enum Verdict {
  PASS
  FAIL
  INCONCLUSIVE
  ERROR
}

type Document {
  version: Int!

type Node {
  id: ID!
  kind: NodeKind!
  number: String
  text: String
  requirement: Requirement
  children: [Node!]!
}

enum NodeKind {
  HEADING
  PROSE
  REQUIREMENT
}
